title: MetricReading
description: A figure an app declared (metric.v1), read at a moment for a reader, under her rights (doctrine D-052): its value over a period, the value of the period before when she compares, and the filters it applied. A board, an app's home and a summary show readings; a summary keeps them frozen.

name.description: The metric's name, as its app declares it: « finance.available ».

value.description: In the metric's unit; money in the currency's smallest unit. Null: nothing to count, or the reader may not read it (`denied`).

previous.description: The value over the period just before, of the same length, when the reader compares.

currency.description: For a metric in money: ISO 4217.

period.description: The days it covers, both included; none for « everything ».

filter.description: The filters it applied — only those on its axes; a filter asked on another axis is left out, and the reader is told the figure is not filtered.

denied.description: True: the reader may not read this figure; its value is null.

missing.description: True: its source did not answer when it was read; its value is null. A figure missing is shown missing, never as zero (doctrine D-062, R17; added in v1: additive).
